unsupported_gap_claims: - `maxBodyBytes` and `maxEntries` come only from the overlay (`shipping.json`). If the overlay omits them, `Buffer.byteLength(text) > undefined` is false and the body is unbounded (`wire.mjs:5`). `decodeEntries` would also reject every request, because `value.length > undefined` is false and so it would accept unlimited entries. — Undefined limit does not make valid arrays reject: the length comparison is false. The same sentence correctly says unlimited entries, but the definite every-request rejection assertion is false.
